purpose: Freeze the chip abstract machine taxonomy for architecture research without replacing the stable mainline gate authority.

layer_taxonomy.name: isa_visible_control
layer_taxonomy.description: Hart-visible control objects such as CSR, command/completion rings, interrupts, and fault lifecycle.

layer_taxonomy.name: dispatch
layer_taxonomy.description: Descriptor decode, dependency ordering, and barrier-domain admission.

layer_taxonomy.name: execution
layer_taxonomy.description: Neuron update, synapse apply, and local event execution engines.

layer_taxonomy.name: memory
layer_taxonomy.description: Control memory, local state memory, synapse memory, and transfer paths.

layer_taxonomy.name: fabric
layer_taxonomy.description: Ingress/egress buffering, routing, multicast, and inter-PE/cluster transport.

time_taxonomy.name: architectural_time
time_taxonomy.description: Epoch, barrier release, and completion visibility boundaries.

time_taxonomy.name: microarchitectural_time
time_taxonomy.description: Queue wait, memory service, router transit, and engine occupancy timing.

time_taxonomy.name: simulator_bookkeeping_time
time_taxonomy.description: Artifact refresh, summary rebuild, and observer/history maintenance time.

counter_taxonomy.name: correctness
counter_taxonomy.description: Accepted/retired command, completion, and fault lifecycle counters.

counter_taxonomy.name: execution_flow
counter_taxonomy.description: Event intake, local execution, spike generation, and barrier wait counters.

counter_taxonomy.name: memory
counter_taxonomy.description: Neuron-state, synapse, backing-memory, and transfer-path counters.

counter_taxonomy.name: congestion
counter_taxonomy.description: Ingress/egress occupancy, router pressure, and backpressure counters.

fused_step_state_machine.semantic_statement: FUSED_STEP is the architectural step primitive for the riscv_snn research model and retires only after architectural state commit, local outbound handover, and barrier visibility are complete.

visibility_domains.architectural_state: software-visible state committed at completion boundary
visibility_domains.microarchitectural_progress: execution progress before completion remains model-visible but not software-visible
visibility_domains.simulator_bookkeeping: artifact refresh and report maintenance never redefine fused-step architectural completion

states.name: Idle
states.entry_condition: No accepted fused-step command is currently active for the hart.
states.exit_condition: A fused-step command is accepted from the command queue.

states.name: Accepted
states.entry_condition: A fused-step command becomes owned by the backend after command admission.
states.exit_condition: Descriptor decode begins for the accepted fused-step command.

states.name: Decoded
states.entry_condition: Descriptor fields and execution intent are decoded from the accepted command.
states.exit_condition: All prerequisite resources are identified and reservation is attempted.

states.name: ResourcesReserved
states.entry_condition: Execution resources, queue slots, and barrier participation are reserved for the fused-step command.
states.exit_condition: The execution engine starts consuming the reserved work.

states.name: Executing
states.entry_condition: Neuron and synapse work for the current step is being processed.
states.exit_condition: Execution-local work is complete and outbound spike handover begins.

states.name: OutboundDraining
states.entry_condition: Locally generated outbound spikes are draining across the egress handover boundary.
states.exit_condition: All local outbound traffic for the step has crossed the local egress/fabric handover boundary.

states.name: BarrierWaiting
states.entry_condition: Local execution is complete but barrier release has not yet become visible to the hart domain.
states.exit_condition: Barrier release becomes visible and completion can be committed.

states.name: Completed
states.entry_condition: Completion boundary conditions are satisfied and a software-visible completion may retire.
states.exit_condition: The hart consumes the completion or advances to the next accepted command.

states.name: Faulted
states.entry_condition: A higher-priority fault reaches the fused-step fault boundary before architectural completion retires.
states.exit_condition: Software clears or rearms fault state according to the control-plane fault contract.

program_control_event_taxonomy.semantic_statement: Program control events freeze the software-visible milestones that reference-program profiles may compose without redefining fused-step completion or fault boundaries.

events.name: completion_visible
events.description: A software-visible completion has retired to the completion surface.

events.name: fault_snapshot_visible
events.description: An accepted fault snapshot is architecturally visible in the fault CSR surface.

events.name: msnnfault_clear
events.description: Software cleared the visible fault snapshot before the next architecturally relevant step.

events.name: fault_snapshot_overwrite_visible
events.description: A later accepted fault overwrote the previously visible fault snapshot.

events.name: barrier_wait_visible
events.description: The hart reached a barrier-wait architectural boundary before completion became visible.

events.name: barrier_release_visible
events.description: Barrier release became visible to the hart domain and enabled completion retirement.

events.name: stat_snapshot_accepted_visible
events.description: A program-level StatSnapshot command retired a completion carrying the accepted/basic snapshot payload.

events.name: stat_snapshot_completed_count_visible
events.description: A program-level StatSnapshot command retired a completion carrying the completed-count snapshot payload.

events.name: stat_snapshot_provider_bound_visible
events.description: A program-level StatSnapshot command retired a completion carrying the provider-bound snapshot payload.

events.name: stat_snapshot_bad_selector_fault_visible
events.description: A program-level StatSnapshot command retired through an architecturally visible bad-selector fault snapshot.

program_semantic_profiles.semantic_statement: Program semantic profiles freeze how runtime-gate families expand into reference-program traces without allowing family-local Python helpers to redefine the architecture contract.

profiles.semantic_statement: Single-step accepted-fault families retire one architecturally visible faulted step and may inherit family-local divergence points from runtime-gate policy.
Barrier/WFI families first expose a barrier-wait architectural state and then retire a completion only after barrier release becomes visible.
Clear-then-refault families expose one accepted fault, a software-visible clear, and then a second accepted fault snapshot.
Quiescent success families retire a single software-visible completion step.
Accepted/basic StatSnapshot families retire one non-fused program-level control command whose completion payload reports the accepted-command snapshot without reusing fused-step execution semantics.
Completed-count StatSnapshot families retire one non-fused program-level control command whose completion payload reports the completed-command snapshot.
Provider-bound StatSnapshot families retire one non-fused program-level control command whose completion payload reports the backend provider-bound snapshot.
Bad-selector StatSnapshot families retire one non-fused program-level control command through an architecturally visible fault snapshot rather than a successful completion payload.
Overwrite-chain families expose an accepted fault followed by a second accepted fault that overwrites the previously visible snapshot.

memory_taxonomy.semantic_statement: Memory hierarchy for the riscv_snn architecture model is frozen as control-visible state, PE-local hot state, synapse backing, cold backing storage, and explicit transfer paths.

memory_domains.name: ControlMemory
memory_domains.notes: Control-plane visible storage only; does not carry neuron or synapse hot state.

memory_domains.name: LocalStateMemory
memory_domains.notes: PE-local neuron state used during event execution.

memory_domains.name: SynapseMemory
memory_domains.notes: Synapse topology and weight state, distinct from control memory.

memory_domains.name: BackingMemory
memory_domains.notes: Cold storage and large-capacity backing store outside PE-local hot state.

memory_domains.name: TransferPath
memory_domains.notes: Movement path for prefetch, fill, spill, and transfer scheduling; not a persistent storage pool.

fabric_taxonomy.semantic_statement: Fabric taxonomy is frozen as the ordered event path from local ingress receive through remote ingress commit, with divergence limited to explicitly declared microarchitectural pressure points.

stages.name: ingress_receive
stages.description: Receive local or remote events into the ingress side of the chip or processing element.

stages.name: local_classify
stages.description: Classify received events by destination processing element, neuron group, and priority.

stages.name: queue_merge
stages.description: Merge multiple event sources into the local execution queue or merge point.

stages.name: execution_consume
stages.description: Consume queued events into the local execution engine for neuron and synapse work.

stages.name: spike_generate
stages.description: Generate outbound spikes or remote events after local execution completes.

stages.name: egress_enqueue
stages.description: Enqueue outbound traffic into the local egress queue.

stages.name: router_transit
stages.description: Forward traffic through cluster or router fabric toward the remote destination.

stages.name: remote_ingress_commit
stages.description: Commit delivered traffic into the remote ingress side so remote classification may proceed.

program_runtime_evidence_contract.semantic_statement: Program evidence extraction consumes real run_dir artifacts, freezes one authority-backed projection into reference-program summaries, and records which control events came from direct counters versus profile-projected inference.

source_kinds.name: runtime_bridge_run_dir
source_kinds.description: Evidence extracted from the runtime-bridge run_dir referenced by the dated equivalence surface.

source_kinds.name: toolchain_run_dir
source_kinds.description: Evidence extracted from the toolchain bridge run_dir registered in the dated toolchain regress matrix.
